acceptance_criteria: The capability accepts at least three typed material/process ports corresponding to two inputs, a thermal action, and a later addition.
The capability preserves the exact operation order without collapsing steps into a generic numeric model.
The capability returns a structured sequence or trace that distinguishes intermediate state before and after heating.
The capability binding is explicitly reviewed and supplied in the registry inventory.
applicability: Needed when the campaign must express and preserve sequential material operations rather than numeric-only search.
Needed when later steps depend on the exact order of combination, heating, and addition.
gap.evidence_need: A tool binding or reviewed release that accepts typed molecular/process inputs and emits an ordered process graph or state trace for material operations.
gap.graph_gap: No installed reviewed primitive can encode the required chemistry/process graph or sequential material transformation; only numeric search primitives are available.

gap.purpose: Represent and validate an ordered wet-lab style process in which two molecular components are combined, the mixture is heated, and a third component is added afterward, while preserving the required operation order.
